summary: Boundary County crow's nest in the Kaniksu National Forest, dated only to the 1930s and listed as abandoned; 1936 lookout Robert Campbell is the only name on the firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts pages.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: Robert Campbell listed as lookout personnel for 1936

evidence.supports: about 17 miles west of Porthill, Boundary County

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list and firelookout.com both list the crow's nest as Abandoned; neither says it is gone

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1936 name and an undated 1930s crow's nest. The record's status 'gone' is not supported; both lists say Abandoned, so the correction is proposed, not applied. Location: the record's 48.97342, -116.88601 matches the FFLA list; the Idaho Fire Lookouts map uses a different point (about 48.977, -116.832, from the site's map data, not from the page text we quoted), so the two sites disagree on the spot. Record kind 'platform' fits the crow's nest. A bchistoricplaces.org blog post mentions a 1929 fire near Blue Joe Creek but not the lookout; not used. No site description or current condition found in two searches.
